How to Source Rotork, Merlin Gerin and Vickers Spares Sourcing obsolete industrial replacement parts becomes an absolute priority when a manufacturing line stops due to a component failure. In the industrial sector, time isn’t money; it’s net production. The hourly downtime cost skyrockets and all the pressure is on you: you must activate an emergency protocol and find a part that, in many cases, is no longer manufactured. The real headache begins when you turn to official distribution channels: lead times that drag on for months, endless bureaucracy, or the dreaded response: “that component is obsolete, you need to upgrade the entire installation.” At Pymatek , we understand completely that replacing a whole system is rarely a viable or cost-effective short-term option.
